title: Tôi ăn chay
summary: For making the ingredient or dietary limit clear at a stall, cafe, or restaurant counter while the menu item, dish photo, or allergy note stays visible.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: This comes before you order when you need the vegetarian version or a different dish.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say Tôi ăn chay in one connected line before adding details. Point to the actual item, menu line, size, or photo while you say it.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi + ăn carries the core meaning. Use the full line to hear the travel-speed rhythm.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: Vietnamese food interactions move fast, so pointing and short phrases protect the order. Point to the item, menu line, receipt, size, or photo.

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: Watch for a confirmation, a substitute, or question about what is allowed. Point to the actual item, menu line, size, or photo while you say it.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng
phrases.pronunciation: toy bee zee oong dow fohng

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể làm món này không có nguyên liệu này được không?
phrases.english: Can you make it without this ingredient?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the lam mon nay khong co nguyen lieu nay duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Món ăn nào an toàn nhất cho người bị dị ứng này?
phrases.english: Which dish is safest for this allergy?
phrases.pronunciation: Mon an nao an toan nhat cho nguoi bi di ung nay

phrases.vietnamese: Đây là thịt lợn, thịt bò hay thịt gà?
phrases.english: Is this pork, beef, or chicken?
phrases.pronunciation: Day la thit lon thit bo hay thit ga

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: This comes before you order when you need the vegetarian version or a different dish. Watch for a confirmation, a substitute, or question about what is allowed.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có chứa tôm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co chua tom khong

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có nước mắm không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co nuoc mam khong

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Say it before ordering and confirm sauces or broth if the dish usually carries meat stock or fish sauce.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi món này mà không có thịt được không?
phrases.english: Can I order this without meat?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the goi mon nay ma khong co thit duoc khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Vegetarian can mean different things by kitchen. Point to safer dishes if the answer is vague.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: At a stall, cafe, or restaurant counter, the next useful language is usually I am allergic to fish sauce, I am allergic to shellfish, and I cannot eat this because of an allergy.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị dị ứng với nước mắm
phrases.english: I am allergic to fish sauce
phrases.pronunciation: Toi bi di ung voi nuoc mam

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi bị dị ứng với động vật có vỏ
phrases.pronunciation: Toi bi di ung voi dong vat co vo

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi không thể ăn món này vì bị dị ứng
phrases.english: I cannot eat this because of an allergy
phrases.pronunciation: Toi khong the an mon nay vi bi di ung

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đã gọi món này mà không có đậu phộng
phrases.pronunciation: Toi da goi mon nay ma khong co dau phong

phrases.vietnamese: Hãy làm món này mà không cần đậu phộng
phrases.pronunciation: Hay lam mon nay ma khong can dau phong
